new_engines_to_create.name: Z3ToleranceAllocatorEngine
new_engines_to_create.solves: v7.B row 11 — min Σ cost(t_i) s.t. Σ t_i² ≤ T_assembly² (worst-case) or T_assembly²/k (RSS)
new_engines_to_create.z3_idiom: Optimize() with Real('t_i'), add_soft for cost, add for sum-of-squares constraint

new_engines_to_create.name: MIPSchedulingEngine
new_engines_to_create.solves: v7.B row 12 — argmax Σ(margin·accept) s.t. Σ(hours·accept) ≤ capacity, accept ∈ {0,1}

new_engines_to_create.name: GeometricToleranceSolverEngine
new_engines_to_create.solves: v7.B row 39 — GD&T datum-feature constraint propagation
new_engines_to_create.z3_idiom: BitVec for datum frames, Real for tolerance zones

query_patterns.name: analogy
query_patterns.algorithm: Find target_node with cos_sim > 0.75 AND ≥2 shared edge-type-classes

query_patterns.name: find_similar

query_patterns.name: transitive_deps

query_patterns.name: creative_combination

why_highest_leverage: Schema-level enforcement = automatic CI gating via existing schema-version-check.ts
Cannot be bypassed without explicit schema bump
Zod validation runs on every envelope write
atomic-roadmap-emit.mjs requires these on every emit

defense_in_depth.mechanism: Block session close on unit with score < 0.70; in MINIMAL_ALLOWLIST
Last line of defense for PRs from forks

gate_binding_4_line_zod_patch.tier_invocation_cross_check: Hook validates tier_invocation against AISystemRouterEngine telemetry; flags inconsistency if unit claims [T6] but no Z3 invocation logged

threshold_tuning.method: Sample 200 successful + 50 reworked JM Die programs; back-compute Omega via omegaDispatcher.computeOmega(R,C,P,S,L); build ROC curve; set floor at Omega@95th-percentile-of-reworked-jobs
threshold_tuning.rationale: JM Die's estimated 92–95% ship-first-pass rate for established customer programs
threshold_tuning.iteration_plan: Start at spec's 0.70, run for one MS2 milestone, recalibrate from telemetry
threshold_tuning.safety_threshold: S(x) is binary-ish in practice; 0.70 floor reasonable as 'no high-severity violations' but should progressively shift to constraint-list check rather than scalar; tie into Bayes prior infra at guardDispatcher.ts:31

summary.one_line: v7.C v2: T1/T2/T4/T5 already real; T3 weights+fallback-marker+Stop-hook; T6 wires 3 new engines + router to already-installed z3-solver; T7 renames existing + new KG engine over already-installed Qdrant+Xenova; 4-line Zod patch enforces Omega≥0.70 + S(x)≥0.70 + tier_invocation schema-wide; zero new deps.
